description: Building utility tool for oxidizing, restoring and waxing copper blocks. Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric.

mods.name: Maikura Coppersmith Tool
mods.description:
銅ブロックの酸化・復元・ワックス管理を行う建築支援ツール。

右クリックで酸化。
左クリックで復元。
Shift+右クリックで未ワックス銅の検出表示を切り替え。

銅細工師ツール・極では、自動ワックス塗布とワックス残量管理が利用できます。

releases.notes:
## Maikura Coppersmith Tool v1.0.12

### Added
- Added support for Copper Lantern oxidation/restoration/wax detection.
- Added support for Copper Golem Statue oxidation/restoration/wax detection.

### Changed
- Right click: oxidize copper blocks.
- Left click: restore copper blocks.
- Shift + right click: toggle unwaxed copper highlight only.
- Holding left/right click repeats oxidation/restoration at a controlled interval.
- Re-clicking responds immediately.

### Fixed / Improved
- Prevented normal block breaking on supported copper blocks while using the Coppersmith Tool.
- Added swing animation during repeated restoration.
- Improved control compatibility with Beacon Core construction mode.

### Supported
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric

releases.notes:
# Maikura Coppersmith Tool v1.0.0

Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric 用の建築支援MODです。

## Features

- Right click to oxidize copper blocks
- Shift + Right click to restore copper blocks
- Toggle unwaxed copper highlighting
- Supports copper blocks, doors, trapdoors and chains

## Coppersmith Tool Kiwami

- Automatic waxing
- Wax storage system
- Honeycomb refills

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric
